_meta.description: Conventional ventilation airflow rates (Qvarep: extracted, Qvasouf: supplied, per m2 of living area; Smea: air-inlet modules) per ventilation type, conventional envelope airtightness Q4Pa-conv per construction period (single-family houses), wind-shelter coefficients e/f, and average ventilation auxiliary power for single-family homes. In the 3CL method the heat-recovery benefit of balanced ventilation is embedded in its low conventional Qvarep values (no separate recovery efficiency).
_meta.source: Annexe 1 (méthode 3CL-DPE 2021) de l'arrêté du 31 mars 2021 modifié : tableau des débits conventionnels §4 (p.40), Q4Paconv/m² et cas particuliers §4 (p.39), coefficients e/f (p.39), formules Hvent=0,34·Qvarep·Sh et Hperm §4 (p.38-39), puissances d'auxiliaires §5 (p.41).
_meta.notes: V1 keeps the subset of ventilation types exposed in the app journey; keys map to VentilationType in models.py. 'period' sub-keys refer to the system installation period. Q4Paconv special cases (pre-1948/1948-74 with wall or ceiling insulation) implemented in envelope.py.

units.q4pa_conv: m3/(h.m2 of deperditive wall area, under 4 Pa)
